author: j-c-ryle
fields.title: Ozaaliddwa Omulundi Ogw’okubiri?
fields.summary: “Omuntu bw’atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri tayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Katonda.” Ryle tagumiikiriza muntu yenna kwesigama ku “Ndi mu kkanisa; era ndowooza nti nzaaliddwa,” wabula akyukira obubonero obweyoleka obw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri ebbaluwa ya Yokaana esooka bw’eteekawo — obulamu obutakyafuula kibi mpisa yaabwo, obukkiriza, obwagala, obuwangula ensi, era obwekuuma. Abuteeka mu maaso, si kubonyaabonya wabula okugezesa, omusomi alyoke amanye, so si kusuubira busuubizi, obanga yazaalibwa Katonda.
main_points: Awatali kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri tewali ayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Katonda.
Okuba mu kkanisa si bukakafu bwa kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri.
Ebbaluwa ya Yokaana esooka etuwa obubonero obweyoleka: abazaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri tebafuula kibi mpisa yaabwe, era bakkiriza Kristo.
Bagalana, bawangula ensi era beekuuma, era obubonero buno butusobozesa okumanya so si kusuubira busuubizi.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Ryle agamba nti okuba mu kkanisa tekimala kuddamu kibuuzo “Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?”
study_questions.answer: Kubanga “enkumi n’enkumi z’Abakristaayo ab’erinnya bwerinnya tebalina na kamu ku bubonero n’obujulizi bw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri Ebyawandiikibwa bye bituwadde.” Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, akinyweza okuva mu bigambo bya Kristo, kwetaagisa omuntu okusobola “okulaba obwakabaka bwa Katonda” — n’olwekyo ekibuuzo ekya nnamaddala kiri nti obubonero buliwo?

study_questions.question: Bubonero ki omukaaga obw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri Ryle bw’aggya mu 1 Yokaana?
study_questions.answer: Oyo azaaliddwa Katonda takola kibi (ng’empisa), akkiriza nti Yesu ye Kristo, akola eby’obutuukirivu (abeera mu bulamu obutukuvu), ayagala abooluganda, awangula ensi, era yeekuuma.

study_questions.question: Ryle agamba nti omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri talina kibi oba nti yatuukirira?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Omuntu ng’oyo akyalina obubi obumubeeramu n’obunafu obwa buli lunaku, naye takyayonoona ng’empisa gy’ayagala — akyawa ekibi era akirwanyisa. Ryle ajuliza John Newton: “Siri nga bwe nsaanidde okuba… naye olw’Ekisa kya Katonda ndi bwe ndi.”

study_questions.question: Ryle ategeeza ki bw’agamba nti “awangula ensi”?
study_questions.answer: Omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri takyafuula “ndowooza ya nsi kye kipimo kye eky’ekituufu n’ekikyamu.” Awangula amasanyu gaayo (agatuuka okumukooya) n’okutya oba okusekererwa kwayo, ng’anoonya okusanyusa Katonda so si bantu.

fields.body_html:
Kino kye kimu ku bibuuzo ebisingayo obukulu mu by’eddiini. Yesu Kristo agamba nti, “Omuntu bw’atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri tayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Katonda.”—Yokaana 3:3.

Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri? Tekimala kuddamu nti, “Ndi mu kkanisa; era ndowooza nti nzaaliddwa.” Enkumi n’enkumi z’Abakristaayo ab’erinnya bwerinnya tebalina na kamu ku bubonero n’obujulizi bw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri Ebyawandiikibwa bye bituwadde.

Wandyagadde okumanya obubonero n’obujulizi bw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri? Mpuliriza, nange nja kubikulaga okuva mu bbaluwa ya Yokaana esooka.

Ekisooka, Yokaana agamba nti, “tewali afuuka mwana wa Katonda ate ne yeeyongera okukola ekibi;” era nate nti, “buli muntu yenna azaalibwa Katonda teyeeyongera kukola kibi.”—1 Yokaana 3:9; 5:18. Omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, takola kibi ng’empisa ye. Takyayonoona n’omutima gwe, n’okwagala kwe, n’okwegomba kwe kwonna, ng’omuntu atazaaliddwa buggya bw’akola. Oboolyawo waaliwo ekiseera lwe yali talowooza oba ebikolwa bye bibi oba si bibi, era nga tannakuwalangako ng’amaze okukola ekibi. Tewaaliwo kukaayana wakati we n’ekibi; baali mikwano. Kaakano akyawa ekibi, akidduka, akirwanyisa, akitwala ng’endwadde ye esinga obubi, asinda wansi w’omugugu gw’okubeerawo kwakyo, akungubaga bw’agwa wansi w’amaanyi gaakyo, era yeegomba okukiwonyezebwako ddala. Mu kigambo kimu, ekibi tekikyamusanyusa, era tekikyali kintu ky’atafaako; kifuuse ekintu eky’omuzizo ky’akyawa. Tasobola kukiziyiza kubeera munda mu ye. Singa yandigambye nti talina kibi, amazima tegandibadde mu ye (1 Yokaana 1:8). Naye ayinza okugamba nti akikyayira ddala ku mutima, era okwegomba okukulu okw’emmeeme ye kwe kutakola kibi n’akatono. Tasobola kuziyiza birowoozo bibi kumujjira munda, n’obunafu, n’ebyo by’alagajjalira, n’ebisobyo okulabika, mu bigambo bye ne mu bikolwa bye. Amanyi, nga Yakobo bw’agamba nti, “Ffenna tusobya mu ngeri nnyingi” (Yakobo 3:2). Naye ayinza okugamba mu mazima, era nga mu maaso ga Katonda, nti ebintu ebyo bimunakuwaza era bimulumya buli lunaku, era nti obutonde bwe bwonna tebubikkiriza.

Akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Eky’okubiri, Yokaana agamba nti, “Buli akkiriza nti Yesu ye Kristo, oyo aba mwana wa Katonda”—1 Yokaana 5:1.

Kale omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, akkiriza nti Yesu Kristo ye Mulokozi yekka emmeeme ye mw’eyinza okusonyiyibwa; nti Ye y’Omuntu ow’obwakatonda eyalondebwa Katonda Kitaffe olw’ekigendererwa kino kyennyini, era nti okuggyako Ye tewali Mulokozi n’omu. Mu ye yennyini talaba kirala wabula obutasaanira, naye mu Kristo alaba ensonga ey’okwesiga okujjuvu, era nga yeesiga Ye akkiriza nti ebibi bye byonna bisonyiyiddwa. Akkiriza nti olw’omulimu gwa Kristo ogwaggwa n’okufa kwe ku musaalaba, abalibwa ng’omutuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda, era asobola okulindirira okufa n’omusango awatali kutya. Ayinza okuba n’okutya n’okubuusabuusa kwe. Oluusi ayinza okukugamba nti awulira ng’alinga atalina kukkiriza n’akatono. Naye mubuuze obanga anaasimba essuubi lye ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo ku bulungi bwe ye, ku kwekyusa kwe, ku kusaba kwe, ku muweereza we, oba ku kkanisa ye, olabe ky’anaakuddamu. Mubuuze obanga anaaleka Kristo, n’ateeka obwesige bwe mu ngeri endala yonna ey’eddiini. Kakasa nti yandigambye nti newakubadde ng’awulira nga munafu era mubi, teyandirese Kristo olw’ensi yonna. Kakasa nti yandigambye nti asanze mu Kristo obw’omuwendo, n’okusaanira emmeeme ye mu Kristo, by’atasanganga walala wonna, era nti ateekwa okumunywererako.

Akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Eky’okusatu, Yokaana agamba nti, “oyo akola eby’obutuukirivu ye mwana we”—1 Yokaana 2:29.

Kale omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, muntu mutukuvu. Afuba okubeera mu bulamu okusinziira ku kwagala kwa Katonda, okukola ebintu ebisanyusa Katonda, n’okwewala ebintu Katonda by’akyawa. Ekigendererwa kye n’okwegomba kwe kwe kwagala Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’emmeeme ye yonna, n’amagezi ge gonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna, n’okwagala muliraanwa we nga bwe yeeyagala. Kye yeegomba kwe kutunuuliranga Kristo bulijjo ng’ekyokulabirako kye era ng’Omulokozi we, n’okweraga nga mukwano gwa Kristo ng’akola buli Kristo ky’alagira. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti tannatuukirira. Tewali ayinza kukikugamba mangu okumusinga ye kennyini. Asinda wansi w’omugugu gw’obubi obumubeeramu obumunywererako. Asanga munda mu ye omusingi omubi ogulwanyisa Ekisa buli kiseera, era ogugezaako okumuwalula okuva ku Katonda. Naye tagukkiriza, newakubadde nga tasobola kuguziyiza kubeerawo. Wadde ng’alina obunafu bwonna, ekkubo lye okutwalira awamu n’okwekubiira kwalyo bitukuvu—ebikolwa bye bitukuvu, by’anyumirwa bitukuvu, n’empisa ze ntukuvu. Wadde ng’akyama era ng’awaba bw’atyo, ng’eryato erikontana n’empewo ekunta mu maaso, obulamu bwe okutwalira awamu bulaga ludda lumu—eri Katonda era ku lwa Katonda. Era newakubadde oluusi ayinza okuwulira ng’agudde wansi nnyo ne kiba nti yeebuuza obanga ddala Mukristaayo, emirundi mingi ajja kusobola okugamba wamu ne John Newton omukadde nti, “Siri nga bwe nsaanidde okuba, siri nga bwe njagala okuba. Siri nga bwe nsuubira okuba mu nsi endala, naye era siri nga bwe nnali edda, era olw’Ekisa kya Katonda ndi bwe ndi.”

Era n’akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Eky’okuna, Yokaana agamba nti, “ffe tumanyi nga twava mu kufa, ne tuyingira mu bulamu, kubanga twagala abooluganda”—1 Yokaana 3:14.

Kale omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, alina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abayigirizwa ba Kristo bonna ab’amazima. Nga Kitaawe ali mu ggulu, ayagala abantu bonna n’okwagala okunene okwa bonna, naye alina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abo abalina endowooza emu naye. Nga Mukama we era Omulokozi we, ayagala n’aboonoonyi abasingayo obubi, era asobola okubakaabira; naye alina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abo abakkiriza. Tawulira nga ali waka okusinga bw’aba nabo. Tasanyuka nnyo okusinga bw’aba mu batukuvu n’ab’ekitiibwa ab’ensi. Abalala bayinza okussaamu ekitiibwa okuyiga, oba obugezi, oba obukkakkamu, oba obugagga oba ekifo ekya waggulu, mu bantu be balonda okubeera nabo. Omuntu azaaliddwa obuggya assaamu ekitiibwa Ekisa. Abo abalina Ekisa ekisingayo obungi, era abasinga okufaanana Kristo, be bo b’asinga okwagala. Awulira nti b’omu maka ge gamu naye. Awulira nti bannaabwe mu ggye, abalwanyisa omulabe y’omu. Awulira nti bannaabwe mu lugendo, abatambulira ku kkubo lye limu. Abategeera, nabo bamutegeera. Ye nabo bayinza okwawukana ennyo mu ngeri nnyingi—mu kitiibwa, mu kifo, mu bugagga. Kiki ekyo? Bantu ba Yesu Kristo. Be batabani ba Kitaawe era bawala be. Kale tayinza butabaagala.

Era n’akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Eky’okutaano, Yokaana agamba nti, “buli mwana wa Katonda awangula ekibi n’okwegomba ensi”—1 Yokaana 5:4.

Omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, tafuula ndowooza ya nsi kye kipimo kye eky’ekituufu n’ekikyamu. Tafaayo kukontana na mugga gw’amakubo g’ensi, endowooza zaayo n’empisa zaayo. “Abantu banaayogera ki?” tekikyali kye kimusalirawo. Awangula okwagala ensi. Tasanga ssanyu mu bintu abasinga obungi abamwetoolodde bye bayita essanyu. Tasobola kunyumirwa bye banyumirwa: bimukooya: bimulabikira nga bya bwereere, ebitaliimu magoba, era ebitasaanira kitonde ekitafa. Awangula okutya ensi. Akkiriza okukola ebintu bingi abo bonna abamwetoolodde bye balowooza nga tebyetaagisa, okwogera ekitono. Bamunenya: tekimunyeenya. Bamusekerera: teyeekuba ku ludda. Ayagala ettendo lya Katonda okusinga ettendo ly’abantu. Atya okunyiiza Katonda okusinga okunyiiza abantu. Abaze omuwendo. Gy’ali kintu kitono obanga anenyezebwa oba atenderezebwa. Takyali muddu wa mulembe na mpisa za nsi. Okusanyusa ensi gy’ali nsonga ya kubiri ddala. Ekigendererwa kye ekisooka kwe kusanyusa Katonda.

Era n’akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Eky’omukaaga, Yokaana agamba nti, “Oyo eyazaalibwa Katonda yeekuuma”—1 Yokaana 5:18.

Omuntu azaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, oba azaaliddwa obuggya, yeegendereza nnyo ku mmeeme ye. Afuba si kwewala kibi kyokka, naye era n’okwewala buli kintu ekiyinza okumutwala mu kyo. Yeegendereza ku bantu b’atambula nabo. Awulira nti emikwano emibi gyonoona omutima, era nti obubi busiigibwa mangu nnyo okusinga obulungi, nga endwadde bw’esiigibwa okusinga obulamu. Yeegendereza ku nkozesa y’ebiseera bye: ky’asinga okwegomba ku byo kwe kubimala mu ngeri ey’omugaso. Yeegendereza ku mikwano gy’akola: tekimumala nti abantu ba kisa era balungi era ba mpisa nnungi; ebyo byonna birungi nnyo; naye banaagasa emmeeme ye? Yeegendereza ku mpisa ze eza buli lunaku n’enneeyisa ye: agezaako okujjukira nti omutima gwe gwe mulimba, ensi ejjudde obubi, era Setaani bulijjo afuba okumukola akabi; era n’olwekyo, yandyagadde mu mazima okubeeranga bulijjo ng’ali bulindaala. Yeegomba okubeera ng’omuserikale mu nsi y’abalabe, okwambalanga ebyokulwanyisa bye bulijjo, n’okubeera nga yeetegese okukemebwa. Asanga mu bumanyirivu nti emmeeme ye bulijjo eri wakati mu balabe, era afuba okuba omuntu atunula, omwetoowaze, era asaba.

Era n’akabonero kano nkateeka mu maaso go. Omutume yandyogedde ki ku ggwe? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?

Obwo bwe bubonero obunene omukaaga obw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri. Buli muntu atuuse nange wano, abusome n’obwegendereza, abuteeke ku mutima.

Mmanyi nti waliwo enjawulo nnene mu buziba n’obweyolefu bw’obubonero buno mu bantu ab’enjawulo. Mu bamu bunafu, tebulabika bulungi, bwa maanyi matono, era kizibu okubwawula. Mu balala bwa maanyi, bwogi, butangaavu, bweyoleka, era tebuyinza kukyamya, ne kiba nti omuntu yenna ayinza okubusoma. Obumu ku bubonero buno bweyoleka nnyo mu bamu, n’obulala bweyoleka nnyo mu balala. Tekitera kubaawo nti bwonna bweyoleka kyenkanyi mu mmeeme emu. Bino byonna ndi mwetegefu ddala okubikkiriza.

Naye era oluvannyuma lw’okukkiriza byonna, wano tusanga nga bisiigiddwa mu lwatu obubonero omukaaga obw’okuzaalibwa Katonda. Wano waliwo Omutume eyaluŋŋamizibwa ng’awandiika emu ku bbaluwa ez’enkomerero ez’awamu eri Ekkanisa ya Kristo, ng’atugamba nti omuntu azaaliddwa Katonda, Takola kibi, Akkiriza nti Yesu ye Kristo, Akola eby’obutuukirivu, Ayagala abooluganda, Awangula ensi, era Yeekuuma. Nsaba omusomi yeetegereze bino byonna.

Kaakano tunaayogera ki ku bintu bino? Abo abakkiriza nti okuzaalibwa obuggya kwe kuyingizibwa obuyingizibwa mu bisanyizo bya kkanisa eby’okungulu kye bayinza okwogera, mazima simanyi. Nze nzekka ŋŋamba n’obuvumu nti nsobola okutuuka ku nsonga emu yokka. Ensonga eyo eri nti abantu abo bokka abalina obubonero buno omukaaga be bazaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri; era nti abasajja n’abakazi bonna abatalina bubonero buno tebazaaliddwa mulundi gwa kubiri. Era nzikiriza ddala nti eno y’ensonga Omutume gye yayagala tutuukeko.

Omusomi, olina obubonero buno? Ozaaliddwa omulundi ogw’okubiri?
